description.value: This Subway franchise operates inside the Seafair Shopping Centre in Richmond, offering made-to-order Footlong and 6" sandwiches, wraps, and salads. It serves breakfast and provides catering, delivery, and curbside pickup in addition to in-restaurant dining. For a touring cyclist, it is a convenient stop along No. 1 Road for a customizable, filling meal.

address.value: 8671 Number 1 Road, Unit 6, Richmond, BC V7C 1V2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Subway website for this location confirms the address (8671 No 1 Rd Unit 6, Richmond, BC V7C 1V2), phone number (604-274-8868), and that the restaurant is actively operating within the Seafair Shopping Centre. OSM tag takeaway=yes and the website listing of 'Order Pick Up' and 'curbside pickup' services confirm takeout. No evidence exists in either OSM tags or website content for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities.
